text:
Type: round metal side table with shelf
Use: holding a lamp, drinks or a plant beside a seat or bed; living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: contemporary, minimalist, retro
Materials: white powder-coated steel top and frame, small round metal shelf
Colors: white
Shape: thin round top, small round shelf halfway down, slender rod frame ending in curved outward-flaring feet, delicate and open, light visual weight
Feel: airy, graceful, light, fresh
Goes with: white or pastel walls, light wood, soft textiles; small living rooms, bedrooms, Scandinavian or modern apartments
